title: Tara Anne Sport Fishing

services.name: Tara Anne Sport Fishing
services.desc: Whether you are deep sea fishing NJ for Shark, Tuna, Blues or other great fighting fish. Let Captain Joe Lyons and Captain Nick Lyons and the crew of the Tara Anne help you land the Big ones! Charter boat fishing is fantastic in New Jersey from April through to December. There are wonderful areas all along the east coast and you will be up against some of the best fighting fish in the sea. Captain Joe has been an avid fisherman since he was a child, he has spent virtually every summer of his life “down the shore” fishing.
